mapper.select: SELECT 'SUSB' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYMM') || LPAD(NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(MNG_NO, 9))), 0) + 1, 4, '0') FROM TB_GM01M01 WHERE CO_CD = #{coCd} AND MNG_NO LIKE 'SUSB' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYMM') || '%'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_GM01M01 ( CO_CD, MNG_NO, OUT_DT, USB_CD, OUT_DEPT_ID, OUT_DEPT_NM, OWN_DEPT_ID, OWN_DEPT_NM, OWN_USER_ID, OWN_USER_NM, VEND_CLNT_CD, VEND_CLNT_NM, VEND_USER_NM, SALES_CD, CLNT_PJT, CLNT_PJT_NM, EQP_NM, RMK, CREAT_ID, CREAT_DTTM, CREAT_PGM ) VALUES ( #{coCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{mngNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{outDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{usbCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NVL(#{outDeptId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, (SELECT CODE_ETC FROM TB_CM05M01 WHERE CODE_ID = #{usbCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ROWNUM = 1)), NVL(#{outDeptNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, (SELECT DEPT_NM FROM TB_CM04M01 WHERE DEPT_ID = (SELECT CODE_ETC FROM TB_CM05M01 WHERE CODE_ID = #{usbCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ROWNUM = 1) AND ROWNUM = 1)), #{ownDeptId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ownDeptNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ownUserId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ownUserNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{vendClntCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{vendClntNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{vendUserNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{salesCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{clntPjt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{clntPjtNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{eqpNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{rmk, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, #{pgmId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
